description: Per-deceased memorial NFT mint attestation. G3 STRUCTURAL: afterlifeDoctrineImposed const false (Charter §1.15 non-eschatological invariant; extends kataribe G4 pattern to memorial domain). Cross-link to musubi.ceremonyPerformanceAttestation (funeral type) + chigiri.inheritanceChain. Cross-doctrinal honor text accommodates Christian + Buddhist + Shinto + nondenominational + secular memorial preferences (G4).

deceasedPseudonymDid.description: 30-day rotating pseudonym DID per ADR-2605181200 (post-death; family-signed)

memorialNftMintTxCid.description: On-chain memorial NFT mint transaction CID (Base L2; ERC-4337 paymaster-sponsored)

memorialNftMetadataCid.description: IPFS CID of memorial NFT metadata (honor text + dates + cross-doctrinal accommodation)

afterlifeDoctrineImposed.description: G3 STRUCTURAL: const false; Charter §1.15 non-eschatological invariant; honors deceased without imposing afterlife doctrine

doctrinalAccommodation.description: G4 cross-doctrinal accommodation; member-directive-respecting if member opted for no doctrine

memberDirectiveCid.description: Cross-link to chigiri.member_onboarding burial-or-cremation directive (G9 free conscience)

burialOrCremation.description: G7 STRUCTURAL: const-set excludes embalming chemicals (Charter §2(d))

cemeteryLandAttestationCid.description: If burial, cross-link to cemeteryLandAttestation (waqf-inalienable per G10)
